title.en: Maps, directions and a year review

text.en: Follow Avi and Soni through the fair: walk on the blue lane, turn right on the green lane, then left towards the red lane, and meet Dada and Dadi at the chaupal.

A map shows where places are. Look at the Surajkund fair map and find the restaurant, stalls, ATM and exits.
Directions use words like left, right and straight. Follow the path step by step.
Walk on the blue lane, turn right on the green lane, take a left towards the red lane and the first left towards the golden lane to reach the chaupal.
Tell someone the way from the chaupal to the ATM using left and right.
There are two exits: one is a maze and one goes straight. Share the way you took through the maze.
This is the last chapter, so recall the year: counting to 1000, adding and subtracting, tables of 2, 5 and 10, halves and quarters, measuring, time and shapes.

problem.en: Give directions from the chaupal to the ATM.

text.en: Say left, right or straight at each turn.
Check by walking the path with a finger.

points.en: Use left and right to give directions.
